title: Asymptotically sharp bounds for affine subspace statistics in $\mathbb F_2^n$
summary: Given a subset $A \subseteq \mathbb F_2^n$, we can consider the distribution of the intersection size of $A$ with a uniformly random $d$-flat $F$. Motivated by the edge statistics problem and the hypercube statistics problem, the affine subspace statistics problem concerns the maximum of $\mathbb{P}[|F\cap A|=s]$ among $A \subseteq \mathbb F_2^n$ for any fixed $s\in\{1,\dots,2^d\}$ over a uniformly random $d$-flat $F$.
